title: isequaln
summary: Test array equality while treating NaN values as equal.

gpu_support.notes: GPU tensors are gathered to host before recursive comparison.

description: `isequaln(A, B, ...)` returns true when every input has matching shape, compatible class, and equal contents, with `NaN` values considered equal.
behaviors: Accepts two or more inputs and compares every input against the first.
Treats `NaN` values as equal, including inside numeric arrays, complex values, cells, and structs.
Requires arrays to have identical shape.
Compares cell arrays and structs recursively.

faqs.question: How is `isequaln` different from `isequal`?
faqs.answer: `isequaln` treats `NaN` values as equal. `isequal` returns false when corresponding values are both `NaN`.

gpu_residency: GPU inputs are gathered to host and the result is a host logical scalar.
gpu_behavior: `isequaln` does not currently execute comparison on device; it gathers GPU tensors before comparing values recursively.
